notes: Stored edit (scurvy: functional, caused_by_deficiency_of). Related near is the functional exclusion; related far reaches scurvy through the sailors' disease (binding). Derived: composition through what the skin makes in sunlight, fat-solubility and rickets (the citrus-fruit question was replaced: its bridge, that citrus fruit has almost no vitamin D, had no good source). The one indeterminate query is the gum signs (background beliefs): tied to vitamin C by name they stay vitamin C, tied to scurvy they follow its cause. A review remark that every model answers vitamin C there is not an objection: that is the by-name world, and the by-description world is the point, as in the template's Parliament query. The zh and negation questions were missed by several models in the old audit; propositional and cross-lingual questions may be missed (CRITERIA Rule 6), and what must hold is the fact underneath (scurvy's cause), which the direct, paraphrase and related questions check. Evidence: composed forms were counted again with the shared counter; the older counts are kept. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
